name: Futuristic
oneLiner: Tech-forward typography and sleek framing that position a product as the next version of itself.

notes: Clipped corners remove hit area at the edges: keep the focus ring outside the clip so it stays visible.
The cyan accent is legible on near-black but not on the panels' translucent surface; keep body copy at the text role.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 42px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% 100%, 10px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 10px))

default.base: padding: 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.25); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)
font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-accent)
font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 2.25rem; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--uiux-color-text)
height: 42px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.3); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem
default.focusVisible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.2)

do: Draw the interface as a HUD: thin cyan lines, clipped corners, tabular readouts.
Keep the canvas near-black and the accent cool; warmth breaks the illusion.
Track labels wide and set them small; set numbers large and monospaced.
dont: Do not use curved or heavily rounded shapes — the geometry is machined.
Do not animate scan lines or glitch effects over readable content.
Do not introduce a warm accent for danger; use the danger role only for a real failure.
antiPatterns: A blurred glass card on a HUD grid.
Faux code rain behind a dashboard.
Cyan text on near-black at 2:1 for secondary labels.
